claims.statement: every in-scope action was judged by the gateway and recorded before its effect was released
claims.mechanism: signed evidence token per action, hash chain, RFC 6962 tree, write before release; since 10 September 2026 performed by the attested gateway in service mode, on a capability the principal signed for the task
claims.fact_evidenced: existence, order and integrity of the judgement record for each action
trust_analysis: Google's hypervisor and disk (a project owner can snapshot it; audit-logged)

claims.statement: each repository-changing action carried a certificate of premises that verified against the material beside the record
claims.mechanism: ProveML certificate, store, registry and provenance; replay by PHP gate, proveml-go and the ProveML JavaScript package
claims.fact_evidenced: the certificate's digests and the verifier's boolean, recomputable by a stranger
trust_analysis: the OSV advisory data the hands read (graded inferred/gateway)

claims.statement: the chain head existed by the anchored time and has not been rewritten below the anchored size
claims.mechanism: RFC 3161 timestamp (DigiCert) and Hedera Consensus Service on the signed checkpoint, daily
claims.fact_evidenced: a consensus time and a TSA time for a given root and head
claims.note: Hedera testnet until first external use; the mechanism satisfies 7.3.3 (single-history consensus)

claims.statement: the record names the agent by a fragment of a DID whose key history is signed
claims.mechanism: did:webvh log at abovebeyond.ai with pre-rotation; the update key on a hardware token; every version pinned at DigiCert and on the Hedera topic, the ledger's first posting per version compared with the log (anchor identity check, control v0.10.0)
claims.fact_evidenced: which key was valid for the agent at the record's time
trust_analysis: the operator's update key custody: a hardware token with PIN and touch since 11 September 2026, the next key on a second token kept apart
claims.note: Hedera testnet until first external use; a did:webvh witness was not added, a named witness being a single trusted party (8.1.2); the ledger gives one history with no party to trust, as for history-anchored

claims.statement: the production gateway's key was generated inside an Intel TDX trust domain, is bound in the hardware quote, and the quote's digest is anchored with every checkpoint
claims.mechanism: TDX quote with REPORTDATA = SHA-512('poc-evidence-key\0' || key); MRTD as the record's measurement; daily refresh
claims.fact_evidenced: that the signer of shadow records runs inside the measured domain
trust_analysis: Google's hypervisor and disk (snapshot by a project owner, audit-logged)
claims.note: production since 10 September 2026 14:20 UTC; no login path to the VM since 14:45 UTC; Tier 3 with the rest once 8.1.5 is recorded by an outsider

claims.statement: every action was performed on a capability the principal signed for that task, narrowing the standing grant
claims.mechanism: Ed25519 token over RFC 8785 canonical payload (iss #portal, sub the hand, aud the gateway, task, kinds, resources, exp), verified by the gateway, digest and task on the record
claims.fact_evidenced: which signed task each action was performed under, and that the action lay within it
trust_analysis: Portal's capability key custody (a file on the Portal server, published as #portal)
